> **Extension Name:**
> Subtitle Engine
> 
> **Version:**
> 1.0.0
> 
> **GitHub Repository / Download Link:**
> [Click Here](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Thekingcrusher/seanime-plugins/refs/heads/main/subtitle-engine/manifest.json)  / Copy the link below: 
> ```https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Thekingcrusher/seanime-plugins/refs/heads/main/subtitle-engine/manifest.json```
> **Description:**
> Add subtitles of your preferred language and format scraped from multiple different sources to your current session.
> 
> **Additional Notes:**
> Only compatible with Seanime's built-in player. Only tested with online streaming so let me know if there are any problems or if any languages are missing.
> 
> Preferences
> auto select - automatically adds subtitles based on users set preference upon playing episode
> 
> smart select - If user has a preferred format, CC turned on, or both and don't return any results, it will automatically broaden the search—first by searching all formats, and then by disabling the CC filter—to find the best available match.
> 
> source/language/format/CC/sign-song/honorifics - sets the default/preferred settings
> 
> prioritize speed - changes how fast the fetch speed is for AnimeTosho (Integrated) with [drawbacks](https://discord.com/channels/1224767201551192224/1462667157585530942/1466338662034968636)
> 
> id mapping methods - don't really need to touch this it just sets which id mapping fallback method is used. you can see each methods repo below
>
